name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise
steps: Sit upright on a bench with dumbbells beside your hips and a soft bend in your elbows.
Lift both arms out and slightly forward until your elbows approach shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells without resting them against your thighs.
tips: Keep your neck long as your arms rise.
Avoid rocking your torso forward and back to swing the dumbbells upward.
